notes.title: Night map bugfixes patch #2
notes.content:
-Fixed: Respawning on death at the end of the challenge would not work.
-Fixed: Controller Back button not working in Observatory
-Lowered number of missable fish in the club challenge
-Only a tiny bit lowered the difficulty of the club challenge at the places where I saw streamers die way too much, since too much frustration is not the point of this game.
-Bing Bling will now tell you that you have to touch All the Falling Platforms to win
-Fixed: funny camera shot getting stuck on SEAL after the dialogue with Moony
-Fixed: Behind the club, and in the Night Forest, there were spots where you could jump out the level.
-Fixed: fishes from hacker house, in the drawers, would respawn when exiting and coming back inside the house
-Metal box dialogue in museum would replay when coming back to that level
